notes.title: Twisty's Asylum Escapades now has controller support!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26227882/4cf41247d36436bfc6ff23c98780b08dd3a48c04.jpg[/img]

[b]Here's a brand new update for you![/b]


We've been working hard to bring you many different improvements with Twisty's Asylum Escapades and we hope you like them. Here's an overview of what you'll be getting this time-

[list]
[*]The game now supports Xbox 360 and Xbox One gamepads
[*]There's lots of various engine and bug fixes as well as performance improvements (hundreds of individual changes that should make the game run even better)
[*]It no longer violates any international treaties (that we know of), and should now be completely in keeping with the Geneva Conventions
[*]The NPCs no longer despawn when you die (this was causing a glitch in the gamplay, but should be fixed now)
[*]Updated German translation of the game
[*]Improved performance in certain areas of the game that were lagging too much before
[/list]

We hope this makes the game even more enjoyable for you, and don't ever hesitate to send any comments or questions about this crazy little action/adventure title. Many of these improvements came from watching your playthroughs of the game, so have fun and keep the videos and the feedback coming!

notes.title: New Twisty's Asylum Escapades Update!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26227882/3b8d900ac9db11f8861ada94de8428250044f975.jpg[/img]

[b]Happy Halloween![/b]

We've got an update for Twisty's Asylum Escapades for you.
It features improvements based on some of the feedback we've gotten so far; including:

[list]
[*]A new "Insane" difficulty level
[*]Modified existing difficulty levels for better gameplay
[*]Improvements to some of the texture/graphic effects
[*]Positive modifications to how you obtain achievements
[*]More flexible saving and loading capabilities
[*]New variation/method for how you can beat the game
[/list] 

Have fun playing this strangely compelling floating killer brain game and never hesitate to let us know what else you'd like to see!
